items.title: File Caddo Parish County business personal property return
items.description: Louisiana business personal property sworn lists (Form LAT 5) are due to the parish assessor by April 1 or 45 days after receipt, whichever is later. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state's guidance applies and the return goes to the county.

items.title: File the Caddo Parish sales and use tax return
items.authority: Louisiana Uniform Local Sales Tax Board / parish tax collector
items.description: Louisiana parishes levy their own sales and use taxes on top of the state's. Returns are due on the 20th of the month after the period. The Uniform Local Sales Tax Board introduced a combined state-and-local return through Parish e-File; sources conflict on the launch (one says January 2026 periods, another reports a delay), so confirm whether the parish still accepts a separate local return. Older parish instructions treat a return as late if not postmarked by the 21st.

items.title: File the Jefferson Parish hotel/motel sales and room occupancy tax return
items.description: Hotels and motels in Jefferson Parish report the sales and room occupancy taxes monthly on Form R-1029DSO, due by the 20th of the following month, filed electronically through LaTAP. The parish Sheriff and Tax Collector separately issues a 3% east bank hotel occupancy return (filed with the regular sales tax return); its due date was not found.

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental

items.title: File the Orleans Parish hotel/motel sales and room occupancy tax return
items.description: Hotels in Orleans Parish register for and report the sales and room occupancy taxes monthly on Form R-1029DSO, due by the 20th of the month for the preceding month (next business day if a weekend or holiday), filed and paid electronically through LaTAP. Hotels with ten or more guest rooms also file the Exhibition Hall Authority tax (Form R-1325).

appliesWhen.description: Operates a hotel, motel or short-term rental
